en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large wooden spa or bathing pavilion with ornate wooden decorations and steep, tower-like roofs in a Russian-influenced style. Flags hang from the front verandah, and trees frame the building. At the lower left there is a caption in pre‑reform Russian script, and at the lower right there is a lighter modern imprint indicating a Latvian archive or collection.
